beats.title: Getting Ready & Packing
beats.description: Shiva, Teja, and little Aashiv get ready for their exciting family road trip to Bhimavaram, packing bags into their car on a bright sunny morning.

beats.title: The Scenic Highway Drive
beats.description: The family car drives through lush green fields, towering coconut groves, and rural Andhra landscapes as Aashiv marvels at the views.

beats.title: Snack Time in the Car
beats.description: Teja opens the colorful snack bag, sharing treats with a joyful Aashiv while they cruise down the tree-lined road.

beats.title: Encounter at the Village Pond
beats.description: The family stops near a tranquil village pond, where Aashiv excitedly watches and quacks along with swimming ducks.

scenes.heading: EXT. HOME DRIVEWAY - MORNING
scenes.action: Golden morning sunlight washes over the driveway. SHIVA, in a navy-blue shirt, loads duffel bags into the car trunk. TEJA laughs joyfully as little AASHIV, wearing a red t-shirt, jumps up and down with unstoppable excitement before leaping onto the back seat.
scenes.dialog:
AASHIV: Are we going to Bhimavaram today?
TEJA (laughing): Yes! Today is our family adventure!
SHIVA: Water bottles packed, snacks packed, Aashiv packed!
AASHIV: Packed!
